name: Preliminary enclosure-lid pressure study
status: Assumed material and loading; not a qualification test
material_description: Illustrative homogeneous isotropic linear-elastic polymer; no material grade or print process selected
load_description: Uniform downward traction on the full top face, normalized to a total 10 N on each mesh
support_description: All three displacement components fixed on the four cylindrical screw-hole walls; idealized rigid attachment
limitations: Material constants and load are illustrative assumptions, not measured properties or specified service conditions.
Screw-hole supports are fully fixed; bolts, preload, contact, gasket and enclosure flexibility are not modeled.
Only the lid is analyzed; electronics, enclosure base, helmet and mounting assembly are excluded.
Linear, static, small-displacement elasticity only; no impact, drop, creep, fatigue, plasticity, thermal, sealing or intrinsic-safety qualification.
No material strength has been selected, so no safety factor or strength pass/fail is calculated.
A successive-mesh comparison is not an absolute error estimate or experimental validation.
